ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: The day after we pioneered the Deep Research product category on Gemini in December 2024, we gathered some of the team behind the product for a discussion.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: We built the system to be versatile, so over time we can expand its capabilities by giving you more control over what it can browse and giving it sources beyond the open web.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: We are excited to see how people use Deep Research, and these real-world experiences will inform how we continue to build and improve Deep Research. Ultimately, our goal is a truly agentic and universally helpful AI assistant.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: With Nano Banana Pro, Gemini's AI image generator and photo editor, you can create high-quality images in seconds and edit photos into countless new creations.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Start with a simple formula.Try <Create/generate an image of>  <subject> <action> <scene> and then build from there. For example, 'Create an image of a cat napping in a sunbeam on a windowsill'.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: With Nano Banana Pro, Gemini's AI image generator and photo editor, you can create high-quality images in seconds and edit photos into countless new creations.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Be specific with as much detail as you can dream.Prompts should include as many specifics as you can think of, so instead of saying, 'Create an image of a woman in a red dress', try 'Create an image of a young woman in a red dress running through a park'. The more details that you provide, the better Gemini is at following your instructions.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: With Nano Banana Pro, Gemini's AI image generator and photo editor, you can create high-quality images in seconds and edit photos into countless new creations.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Take composition, style and image quality into consideration.Think about how you want the elements in your image to be arranged (composition), the visual style that you want to achieve (style), the desired level of image quality (image quality) and the aspect ratio (size). Try something like, 'Generate an image of a blurry poky porcupine flying in space in the style of an oil painting with a 2:3 aspect ratio'.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Creativity is your friend.Gemini is great at creating surreal objects and unique scenes. Let your imagination run wild.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: If you don't like what you see, just ask Gemini to change it. ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.metaDescription: With Nano Banana Pro, Gemini's AI image generator and photo editor, you can create high-quality images in seconds and edit photos into countless new creations.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Consistent with ourAI principles, this AI image generator was designed with responsibility in mind. And to ensure that there's a clear distinction between visuals created with Gemini and original human artwork, Gemini uses an invisibleSynthIDwatermark, as well as a visible watermark to show that they are AI-generated.
ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Gemini's outputs are primarily determined by user prompts and, like any generative AI tool, there may be instances where it generates content that some individuals find objectionable. ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: The day after we pioneered the Deep Research product category on Gemini in December 2024, we gathered some of the team behind the product for a discussion.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: An agentic system
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: What's next
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: We built the system to be versatile, so over time we can expand its capabilities by giving you more control over what it can browse and giving it sources beyond the open web.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: The day after we pioneered the Deep Research product category on Gemini in December 2024, we gathered some of the team behind the product for a discussion.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: An agentic system
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: What's next
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: We built the system to be versatile, so over time we can expand its capabilities by giving you more control over what it can browse and giving it sources beyond the open web.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: We are excited to see how people use Deep Research, and these real-world experiences will inform how we continue to build and improve Deep Research. Ultimately, our goal is a truly agentic and universally helpful AI assistant.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: The day after we pioneered the Deep Research product category on Gemini in December 2024, we gathered some of the team behind the product for a discussion.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: An agentic system
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: What's next
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: We built the system to be versatile, so over time we can expand its capabilities by giving you more control over what it can browse and giving it sources beyond the open web.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: We are excited to see how people use Deep Research, and these real-world experiences will inform how we continue to build and improve Deep Research. Ultimately, our goal is a truly agentic and universally helpful AI assistant.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Start with a simple formula.Try <Create/generate an image of>  <subject> <action> <scene> and then build from there. For example, 'Create an image of a cat napping in a sunbeam on a windowsill'.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.metaDescription: With Nano Banana Pro, Gemini's AI image generator and photo editor, you can create high-quality images in seconds and edit photos into countless new creations.

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Be specific with as much detail as you can dream.Prompts should include as many specifics as you can think of, so instead of saying, 'Create an image of a woman in a red dress', try 'Create an image of a young woman in a red dress running through a park'. The more details that you provide, the better Gemini is at following your instructions.
ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor

ar_a785a135cf80470fb42433228fd0a2cb.rawText: Take composition, style and image quality into consideration.Think about how you want the elements in your image to be arranged (composition), the visual style that you want to achieve (style), the desired level of image quality (image quality) and the aspect ratio (size). Try something like, 'Generate an image of a blurry poky porcupine flying in space in the style of an oil painting with a 2:3 aspect ratio'.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: We built the system to be versatile, so over time we can expand its capabilities by giving you more control over what it can browse and giving it sources beyond the open web.

ar_1ad935aff81547c9a67bc887e37232c9.rawText: We are excited to see how people use Deep Research, and these real-world experiences will inform how we continue to build and improve Deep Research. Ultimately, our goal is a truly agentic and universally helpful AI assistant.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: The day after we pioneered the Deep Research product category on Gemini in December 2024, we gathered some of the team behind the product for a discussion.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: We built the system to be versatile, so over time we can expand its capabilities by giving you more control over what it can browse and giving it sources beyond the open web.
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_bcad4378755c48049964287fe83982f9.rawText: We are excited to see how people use Deep Research, and these real-world experiences will inform how we continue to build and improve Deep Research. Ultimately, our goal is a truly agentic and universally helpful AI assistant.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Claude Opus 4.5 delivered an impressive refactor spanning two codebases and three coordinated agents. It was very thorough, helping develop a robust plan, handling the details and fixing tests. A clear step forward from Sonnet 4.5."

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Claude Opus 4.5 excels at long-horizon, autonomous tasks, especially those that require sustained reasoning and multi-step execution. In our evaluations it handled complex workflows with fewer dead-ends. On Terminal Bench it delivered a 15% improvement over Sonnet 4.5, a meaningful gain that becomes especially clear when using Warp’s Planning Mode."

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Claude Opus 4.5 delivers high-quality code and excels at powering heavy-duty agentic workflows with GitHub Copilot. Early testing shows it surpasses internal coding benchmarks while cutting token usage in half, and is especially well-suited for tasks like code migration and code refactoring."

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: “Claude Opus 4.5 delivers measurable gains where it matters most: stronger results on our hardest evaluations and consistent performance through 30-minute autonomous coding sessions.”

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Opus 4.5 beats Sonnet 4.5 and competition on our internal benchmarks, using fewer tokens to solve the same problems. At scale, that efficiency compounds."

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: “Claude Opus 4.5 handles long-horizon coding tasks more efficiently than any model we’ve tested. It achieves higher pass rates on held-out tests while using up to 65% fewer tokens, giving developers real cost control without sacrificing quality.”

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Claude Opus 4.5 is yet another example of Anthropic pushing the frontier of general intelligence. It performs exceedingly well across difficult coding tasks, showcasing long-term goal-directed behavior."

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Claude Opus 4.5 achieved state-of-the-art results for complex enterprise tasks on our benchmarks, outperforming previous models on multi-step reasoning tasks that combine information retrieval, tool use, and deep analysis."

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "We've found that Opus 4.5 excels at interpreting what users actually want, producing shareable content on the first try. ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: "Claude Opus 4.5 represents a breakthrough in self-improving AI agents. ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: The day after we pioneered the Deep Research product category on Gemini in December 2024, we gathered some of the team behind the product for a discussion.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: An agentic system
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: To build Deep Research, we developed a new planning system that enables Gemini app to work through complex problems. For Deep Research, we trained Gemini models to be capable of:
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Synthesis:Once the model determines enough information has been gathered, it synthesizes the findings into a comprehensive report. In building the report, Gemini critically evaluates the information, identifies key themes and inconsistencies, and structures the report in a logical and informative way, even performing multiple passes of self-critique to enhance clarity and detail.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: New category, new problems, new solutions
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Evolving with new models
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: And with our most capable model, Gemini 2.5, Deep Research is even better at all stages of research, delivering even more insightful and detailed reports

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.title: Nano Banana Pro – Gemini AI image generator and photo editor

ar_3edb024b9e5d48189ed3239a16c8aceb.rawText: Consistent with ourAI principles, this AI image generator was designed with responsibility in mind. ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.

ar_bf96c31a3fa042399ca604746515b971.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: Over the course of a research session, Gemini can process hundreds of pages of content. To maintain continuity and enable follow-up questions, we use Gemini’s industry-leading 1 million token context window complemented with a RAG setup. This effectively allows the system to "remember" everything it has learned during that chat session, making it smarter the longer you interact with it.

ar_a472b45505c1447db49f5885fa8510fb.rawText: When Deep Research launched in December it was powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. With the introduction of Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking (experimental) we were able to dramatically improve both the quality and serving efficiency of this product. With thinking models, Gemini takes more time to plan out its approach before it makes its next steps. This innate characteristic of self-reflection and planning makes it a great fit for these kinds of long running agentic tasks. What we see is that now Gemini is even better at all stages of research and delivers more detailed reports. At the same time, the compute-efficiency of the Flash model allows us to expand access to Deep Research to far more users. We’re really excited about developing on flash and thinking models in general and expect deep research to keep getting better and better.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Breaking down the problem:When presented with a complex user query, the system first formulates a detailed research plan, breaking the problem into a series of smaller, manageable sub-tasks. You’re in control of the plan: Gemini presents it to you, and you can refine it to make sure it’s focused on the right areas.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Research: The model oversees the execution of this plan, and intelligently determines which sub-tasks can be tackled simultaneously and which need to be done sequentially. The model can use tools like search and web browsing to fetch information & reason over it. At each step the model reasons over information available to decide its next move. We introduced a thinking panel for users to follow what the model has learnt so far & what it intends to do next.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: In building Deep Research, we had to work through three significant technical challenges:

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: Research tasks require multiple steps of iterative planning. At each step, the model has to ground itself on all information gathered so far, then identify missing information and discrepancies it wants to explore — all while trading off comprehensiveness with compute and user wait time. Training the model to be effective at long multi-step planning in a data efficient manner enabled us to make Deep Research function in an open domain setting across all topics.

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: A typical Deep Research task involves many model calls over several minutes. This creates a challenge for building agents: It has to be built so that a single failure doesn’t mean having to restart the task from the beginning.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.title: Gemini Deep Research — your personal research assistant
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.metaDescription: Save hours of work with Gemini Deep Research as your personal research assistant from Google.
ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.cleaned_text: a typical deep research task involves many model calls over several minutes this creates a challenge for building agents it has to be built so that a single failure doesn t mean having to restart the task from the beginning

ar_374388d8a09e488781405484d29339b5.rawText: To address this, we developed a novel asynchronous task manager that maintains a shared state between the planner and task models, allowing for graceful error recovery without restarting the entire task. This system is truly asynchronous: you can hop to a different app or quite literally turn off your computer after starting a Deep Research project and the next time you visit Gemini, you’ll get notified when your research is done.
